name: Side panel
summary: The shortlist at capacity: six conversations, newest first, and a View all into the full Chat history page.

looseEnds.title: Adding Settings cost the shortlist a row
looseEnds.detail: The nav went from three live rows to four and from 40 high to 46, so it stands 184 tall rather than 120. The list below it lost that height and now holds six conversations where it held seven. Nothing says six is the intended capacity rather than whatever happens to fit.
looseEnds.ask: Is the shortlist a fixed count or whatever fits? If fixed, it needs stating — it has now changed twice by accident.

looseEnds.title: All three frames are called "Side Panel, filled recents"
looseEnds.detail: Including the one that draws the empty state. The name is the only thing distinguishing the frames in the layer list, and it describes none of them accurately.
looseEnds.ask: Rename to the state each frame draws — empty, four, full.

looseEnds.title: A hidden 302-wide Footer sits inside a 330-wide panel
looseEnds.detail: Every frame carries a switched-off Footer measuring 302 across. The panel around it is 330 — the width it was before the panel grew. The layer is dead, and it is dead at the old size.
looseEnds.ask: Delete it, or is the footer coming back?

looseEnds.title: The second row of each run carries two extra switched-off metadata parts
looseEnds.detail: Rows 2 and 6 hold three metadata text nodes where every other row holds one. The two extra are the memory count and its separator, switched off rather than removed, so the shape of the row depends on which row it is.
looseEnds.ask: Remove the dead parts, or restore the count on every row.

constraints.label: Row title
constraints.summary: One line, 238px wide, truncated with an ellipsis. The overflow control is back on the row, so the title is 60px narrower than it was on the panel drawn over a conversation — most of the drawn titles now cut.

steps.label: Less overflow button and its gap (44 + 16)
SF Pro Text Regular 15px, average advance
